nome: inemaSEO 1 — Foundation: the X-ray and the groundwork of your site

lado_card.texto: With the foundation in place, course 2 teaches you to write the pages only you can write: entity, territory, and your own data.

rodape: INEMA.CLUB · open and free content · INEMA Learning v7.2 format · eventos.inema.pro/inemaseo · inemaSEO method (MIT) · inema.club

inemaseo-pratica.titulo: inemaSEO in practice: the method in 10 steps

inicio.titulo: Foundation: the X-ray and the groundwork of your site
inicio.lead: Before you write any new page, look at your site the way a search engine does. In eight lessons you run a read-only X-ray, verify your site in Search Console and Bing, set the canonical, sitemap, and robots.txt right, take thin pages out of the index, and notify the search engines. All free, with open scripts.
inicio.capa_alt: The owner of a small ceramics workshop looks closely at her notebook screen, sitting at the work table.
inicio.aulas_sub: In the order of the work: understand, look, verify, fix the address, the map, and the door, clean out the thin pages, and notify.

itens: Website owners or small business owners who have never worked with SEO.
People who already have a live site but don't know whether Google and Bing can see the pages.
People who have heard about "showing up in AIs" and want to know what is fundamental and what is a fad.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Run a read-only X-ray on your site and read what it shows.
Verify your site in Search Console and Bing Webmaster and submit the sitemap.
Set one canonical only, a sitemap with real dates, and a robots.txt decided by purpose.
Take thin pages out of the index and notify the search engines only with URLs that return 200.

blocos.t: Where this course fits in the inemaSEO Program
itens: 1 Foundation (this course): the technical foundation. Without it, no content pays off.
2 Content and 3 Measurement: the pages only you can write and the number that matters, the one for searches without your brand.
4 In AIs, 5 With Agents, and 6 Professional: official AI panels, agents doing the repetitive work, and SEO as a service.
All of them follow the inemaSEO method, open (MIT), applied on the portal, the news site, and the events site of INEMA.
